scope: Exhaustive branch-and-bound subdivision in IEEE double precision with a 1e-10 safety margin per box. Per-term one-dimensional ranges are exact up to floating point; Math.sin is not correctly rounded and no directed-rounding interval library is used. A completed sweep therefore removes the sampling gap in the audited floors — nothing was found lower because the whole cube was subdivided, not because a search failed — but it is not yet a machine-checked proof.
method: boxLowerBound + monotonicity reduction (a coordinate whose derivative enclosure misses zero collapses to a face) + widest-coordinate bisection. Without the monotonicity reduction the measured first-order slack of about 0.045*diameter would need boxes of diameter 1e-3, and there are ~1e20 of those in the cube.
